transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Yes, this is Rakesh. How can I help you?

Thank you for confirming. I’m calling regarding your Mumbai Bank credit card. Our records show that the minimum payment of Rs 4,820 was due on 2026-10-15 and hasn't been received yet. Could you please let me know when you plan to make this payment?
I’m really sorry, but I haven’t been able to make any payments because I lost my job a few weeks ago. I don’t have any money right now.
